confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Chilean price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation, especially the 3-star tier, is least certain given mining-driven business demand and July seasonality. Cocktail (about 2x beer, pisco sour basis) and wine (about 1.3x beer) were set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: northern Chilean coastal and mining-service cities, with Iquique as the closest coastal peer and Calama as a reference for mining-driven lodging demand. Food and drink anchors follow Chilean restaurant price levels; lodging is set higher to reflect business travel. Holistic estimate, not checked against live listings.
